attributes.title: 2027 ANIA Annual Conference
attributes.cme_provider: Anthony J. Jannetti, Inc. (ANCC-accredited provider), jointly with ANIA
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ANIA Annual Conference runs March 11 to 13, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency in San Francisco (Embarcadero). It covers clinical informatics, EHR optimization and digital health topics for nurses.

Registration is open. In-person main conference registration costs $695 for ANIA members and $795 for non-members through February 11, 2027, and $795 and $895 after that and on site. A full-conference virtual package with live broadcasts of general and selected breakout sessions costs $695 or $795 and is listed with 15 ANCC contact hours; one-day in-person rates and separately priced pre-conference workshops on March 11 are also offered. Contact hours are provided through Anthony J. Jannetti, Inc., an ANCC-accredited provider. The Hyatt Regency block rate is $235 per night plus tax until February 9, 2027.
